## STRUCTURE MUST KEEP
Create ONE standalone stylized game environment diorama, one scene, landscape 3:2 composition. High-angle quarter-view with ORTHOGRAPHIC PARALLEL PROJECTION throughout. Use one shared XYZ grid and scale: level X/Y edges of the base, paving, building footings, wall tops and level roofs remain parallel to their respective axis at every height. Vertical Z edges are parallel. Show the ENTIRE square-footprint thick block, both planar front cut faces and all connected rear boundaries with generous empty margins; no cropping. The flat square top is extruded straight down by constant depth, corresponding upper/lower corners displaced by the same vertical vector. Straight edges, no bulging floor, curve, bevel, wedge, tapered slab or twisted corner. Soil/foundation layers and large drainage/power services are exposed in the two front cuts, not underground passages.

A single joined L-shaped building, with a longer right wing and shorter left wing, occupies the rear corner; its concave courtyard corner is clearly readable. All building ground-contact walls and footprint segments follow the common X/Y grid with right-angle turns. Stepped LEVEL roofs meet supported vertical walls correctly. Keep visible footing strips, paving-axis lines and major roof edges for judging alignment. Lower straight boundary panels complete the two rear blocking directions. Exactly TWO functional map exits: one near the outer end of the rear-left boundary (approximately 11 o'clock), one near the outer end of the rear-right boundary (approximately 1 o'clock), each a wide closed sliding gate with clear approach, side pocket, turning room and planned unobstructed passage after opening. Other building doors are decorative local entrances. The central combat court and continuous routes to both gates are free of cars, motorcycles, rubble, cables and protruding machines. No unintended rear gap/third exit. Modest visible building/equipment heights, planned no more than about 6.5 m; no high foreground wall. All objects share the ground plane and camera; vehicles may retain their natural curved forms.

## CURRENT SCENE
An aged L-shaped urban building at sunset evening, amber light and soft cool lavender shadows, dry clear air. The road is approximately 60 percent covered by a THIN yellow windblown sand layer in broad connected patches, with about 40 percent exposed charcoal paving. Sand lies on the flat road; no high dunes, deformed road or obscured foundation/outer edge geometry. Faded blue-grey metal cladding, warm grey masonry and broad repaired panels. Abstract painted graffiti on the courtyard walls. One parked car in a left peripheral service bay, one parked motorcycle in a separate right peripheral recess, and one visibly BROKEN utility pole: snapped short concrete stump plus fallen upper section with exposed rebar and contained cables in a front-left maintenance recess. Each is clear of both exit approaches and the central combat space.

The L building has a credible human-scale door and service shutter on its courtyard facades, grounded thresholds, no exposed interior. Approximately 60 percent of its roof plan is occupied by purposeful supported dust-filter machinery, a cylindrical accumulator and reclaimed power equipment, with maintenance gaps and believable ducts/connections. Roof occupancy is functional objects, not paint, dirt or shadow; retain broad plain roof areas. Show building-wide reclaimed technology rather than concentrating every machine underground.

## ART / REFERENCE ROLES
Salvage Cyberpunk across architecture, vehicles, everyday devices and infrastructure: recovered advanced technology, mismatched replacement housings, visibly repaired joints and functional bypass cables. Basic salvage design for this image. Little Devil Inside supplies ONLY art expression: readable stylized 3D game forms, broad organized color planes, selective large wear and restrained detail, distinct matte plaster/painted metal/rubber/glass, subdued reflections. Preserve age and repair history without uniform fine grunge or overpacked tiny parts. No photoreal miniature grain, tilt-shift blur, plastic-toy finish, people, monsters, logos, captions, arrows, UI, green CRT screens, rain or unrelated previous scene props. Graffiti is abstract painted marks, not signage or instructions.

The four input images are REFERENCES ONLY, not existing scenes to edit. Create a fresh scene independently from them. Image 1: basic block, common spatial frame and two cut faces ONLY; ignore neon theme, architecture, lettering and its specific layout. Image 2: two rear blocking directions and functional exit connectivity ONLY; ignore diagram marks, gate shapes and fixed positions. Image 3: large-form/material/light treatment ONLY; exclude its camera, layout, historical world, characters and shop identity. Image 4: large recovered industrial machinery design ONLY; exclude the person, pose, camera and photographic texture density. The explicitly specified orthographic camera governs all geometry. No previous generated image is an input.
